attacks.name: Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Push|: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character may Push it Away |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Shield Throw
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
This attack ignores LOS, and the defender does not benefit from Cover.

|!wild| |*Ricochet|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make an additional Shield Throw attack. This additional attack must target another character within |!range| 3 of the original defender and may be any distance from this character. This additional attack does not have the Ricochet special rule.

attacks.name: Shield Slam
steps: After this attack is resolved, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character may Throw it |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: A Day Unlike Any Other (Affiliation: Avengers)
superPowers.body: The first time each Turn that each allied character spends |!power| to use a superpower, after the |!power| is spent, that allied character gains 1 |!power|.

superPowers.name: Bodyguard
superPowers.body: When another allied character within |!range| 2 is targeted by an attack, this character may use this superpower. This character becomes the target of the attack regardless of range and LOS.

superPowers.name: Vibranium Shield
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by a |!physical| or |!energy| attack, it may use this superpower. Add two dice to this character's defense roll against that attack.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 5 to 6 on Healthy side, and increased from 6 to 7 on Injured side.
A Day Unlike Any Other reworked: it previously allowed to reducing the Power cost of each allied character's first superpower each Turn by 1, to a minimum of 1.
Strike's push is now limited to Size 3 or less instead of Size 2 or less.
Shield Slam's throw is now limited to Size 3 or less instead of Size 2 or less.
Shield Throw's Strength increased from 4 to 5. It now consistently generates 1 |!power| (gainer).
